## What Is MCX Algo Trading Software?


MCX algo trading software automates commodity trades on the Multi Commodity Exchange using rules you set. It connects to your broker and places orders for contracts like gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas.


The right choice comes down to one question: can it automate your exact commodity contract, through your broker, with the rules you need?


Platforms differ in ways a feature list can hide:


-


Some platforms execute MCX trades but offer no historical MCX backtesting.


-


Some connect TradingView alerts to your broker, but you build and test the strategy elsewhere.


-


Some support MCX futures but not every commodity option contract.

It covers futures, options, testing and costs.

### 2. Tradetron: Best for Building and Testing Commodity Strategies

## How to Choose Commodity Algo Trading Software for MCX


Choose the platform that can show your exact MCX setup working end to end, not the one with the longest feature list. Use these five checks.


### Does It Support Your Exact Contract?


"MCX supported" is too broad. Write down your contract before you contact a provider.


-


Note the commodity, futures or options, expiry and any mini contract variant.


-


"Crude oil options through my broker" is a more useful requirement than "commodity trading supported".


-


Ask the provider to show your exact instrument inside the strategy builder and execution flow.


-


Check whether a signal on the underlying future can pick the right option contract.


### Can It Backtest, Paper Trade and Execute Separately?


These are three different capabilities, so one "yes" does not cover all three.


1.


**Historical backtesting** lets you test your commodity, contract type and date range on suitable data with cost assumptions.


2.


**Paper trading** lets you watch today's signals and simulated orders for the same MCX setup.


3.


**Live execution** submits and manages those orders through your broker.


For any historical test, ask for an export of the actual contracts traded. Review expiry handling, missing data, transaction costs and assumed fills. Results can still differ between stages, as explained in our guide on[why backtest, forward test and live results differ.](https://algotest.in/blog/why-is-there-is-difference-between-my-live-trade-vs-forward-test-vs-backtest-results/)


### How Does It Handle the Evening Session and Failures?


MCX trades into the evening, so your automation needs clear session controls. Review the timings in our[MCX trading time guide](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-trading-time/) before setting schedules.


-


Ask for separate controls for stopping new entries and closing open positions.


-


Check that the schedule matches the exchange session and your broker's[square-off](https://algotest.in/blog/what-is-square-off-in-trading/) rules.


-


Ask where each stop-loss is held and what keeps working if the platform or your machine disconnects.


A good demo should also show what happens when:


-


An alert arrives twice.


-


An entry is rejected or only partly filled.


-


The connection drops while a position is open.


-


An exit order does not fill.


-


You stop the strategy manually.


### How Does It Handle Commodity Option Expiry?


Commodity options work differently from index options at expiry. Certain in-the-money commodity options can devolve into futures, which changes your position and margin requirement.


-


Check the expiry rules for your exact contract and broker. Zerodha's commodity options explanation covers this process.


-


Confirm the software handles expiry selection and exit behaviour correctly.


-


Plan for a failed exit, because a scheduled square-off is an instruction, not a guaranteed fill.


### Does It Work With Your Broker for MCX?


A large broker count does not confirm MCX support. Confirm the full combination of software, broker, MCX segment and contract type. Our list of the[best brokers for algo trading in India](https://algotest.in/blog/best-brokers-for-algo-trading-in-india) is a good starting point.


-


Ask for a demo of your intended workflow and inspect the logs.


-


Confirm the broker's current approved API connection process.


-


Use simulated testing to catch setup errors, keeping in mind it cannot reproduce every live fill.

## FAQs


### What is MCX algo trading?


MCX algo trading uses software to place commodity trades on the Multi Commodity Exchange automatically, based on rules you set. Common contracts include gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas futures and options.


### Which is the best MCX algo trading software in India?


It depends on your workflow. Tradetron suits traders who want a hosted builder with advertised MCX backtesting. Algomojo, EzAlgo and TradeBridge suit traders sending signals from other tools. AlgoTest suits existing AlgoTest users adding MCX execution.


### Can I backtest MCX strategies on AlgoTest?


Not yet. AlgoTest supports live MCX execution for Crude Oil, Gold, Natural Gas and Silver futures and options, and MCX historical backtesting is announced as coming.


### Which commodities can I trade on AlgoTest?


AlgoTest supports Crude Oil, Gold, Natural Gas and Silver in futures and options. Zerodha is the currently named MCX broker, with more integrations planned.


### What is the cheapest MCX algo trading software?


EzAlgo's Basic edition is listed at ₹0, but TradingView integration needs a paid Plus or Pro plan. Compare the full cost, including data, alerts, hosting and any base plan.


### What happens to MCX commodity options at expiry?


Certain in-the-money commodity options can devolve into futures at expiry. This changes your position and margin requirement, so check the rules for your contract and broker.
